job: Show work moving to done: a crawl, an import, a run.
purpose: A bar, ring or step strip filled from data-value and data-max. It shows a percentage or a count. Use data-indeterminate only while the total is unknown, and stop it as soon as it is known. Rings come in 16px (inline), 24px (in a row) and 40px (with a centre label). Colour follows state: accent, then success when complete.
useWhen: A job runs and the reader should see how far it has got.
A multi-step flow shows which step is current.
A ring sits inline beside a label while work runs.

avoidWhen.when: Use against a quota or limit.
The wait is short and the total is unknown.
The steps are nameable and navigable.

states.name: indeterminate
states.how: data-indeterminate; slides or spins while the total is unknown

states.name: complete
states.how: data-complete; turns success when data-tone is auto

states.name: empty
states.how: data-empty hides the ring arc at zero

states.name: step done
states.how: data-done on a step of the steps strip

variants.useWhen: A compact circle beside a label or in a row.
A ring with a centre label.
The total is not known yet.
Accent while running, success on completion; the default.
Force red for a failed run.

parts.role: The segments of the steps strip.
